name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 70.6 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.
There are 5 of us, including 2 children.
My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.
The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.
We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.
entries.reference: Meitä on 4 ihmistä ja meillä on 6 matkalaukkua.

entries.source: Room 214 is on the second floor.
I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.
What time does the museum open on Sundays?
My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.
The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.
entries.reference: Viimeinen bussi lähtee kello 23:30 tänä iltana.

entries.source: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.
entries.reference: Minulla on varaus kello 20 kahdelle hengelle.

entries.source: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?
The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.
entries.reference: Kierros alkaa kello 14:15 ja kestää 3 tuntia.

entries.source: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.
How much is a double room for 3 nights?
entries.reference: Paljonko kahden hengen huone maksaa 3 yöksi?

entries.source: This costs 45 euros, including tax.
Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?
The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.
Can I pay the 78 euros by card?
How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?
The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.
entries.reference: Päivän menu maksaa 15 euroa juoma sisältyy.

entries.source: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.
entries.reference: Osoite on Calle Mayor 15, kolmas kerros.

entries.source: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.
entries.reference: Hotellini on Gran Vía 28:ssa, lähellä metroasemaa.

entries.source: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: Suurlähetystö on osoitteessa Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.
The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.
entries.reference: Tapaamispaikka on Plaza del Sol, portti 3.

entries.source: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: Onko tämä tie Carrer de Balmes 112:een?

entries.source: Where is the nearest bus stop?
Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.
entries.reference: Kääntykää liikennevaloista vasemmalle ja jatkakaa sitten 200 metriä suoraan.

entries.source: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?
Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?
entries.reference: Mikä linja menee lentokentälle, linja 5 vai linja 8?

entries.source: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?
How do I get to the old town from here?
The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.
entries.reference: Museo on noin 15 minuutin kävelymatkan päässä aukiolta.

entries.source: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.
I have lost my passport and my wallet.
Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?
entries.reference: Missä on lähin sairaala tai klinikka?

entries.source: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?
entries.reference: Olen allerginen maapähkinöille; sisältääkö tämä ruoka niitä?

entries.source: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.
entries.reference: Joku varasti laukkuni, jossa oli 200 euroa.

entries.source: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
entries.reference: Soittakaa poliisi, kiitos. On sattunut onnettomuus.
